🇸🇦🇾🇪 Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery is burning: the Houthis claim they hit Ras Tanura as satellite images show black smoke over the plant

Riyadh says it shot down 4 drones and hasn't admitted a hit, but the smoke sits over a refinery next to one of the world's largest crude export terminals.

Retired Rear Adm. Mark Montgomery explains why that terminal matters so much.

America's blockade on Iran works because the Gulf's oil keeps moving while Tehran's sits:

"Arab oil is coming out. Iranian oil is not."

This attack came from Yemen, not Tehran, but it hits the spot Mark is watching.

If Saudi exports start choking too, the blockade's best advantage disappears, and Washington has to choose between escalating and cutting a deal.

@MarkCMontgomery

Comedian Shane Gillis gives just a 17-word response after his ex-girlfriend wrote an over 3000 word essay about how she was a victim in their relationship.

At one point in the piece, Grace Brassel complained that she felt she was expected to cook, clean, and do laundry.

In response to the 3000 attention-seeking essay, Gillis said: "Grace and I had some good times together. Breakups are tough, and I wish her the best."

Wow, she was expected to bring something to the relationship, like cooking and cleaning. Horrifying!
